title: Laboratory to Nature: The Green Paradox of Scientific Research

contributions.purpose: 综述湿实验室环境负担与干预点
contributions.mechanism: 2000-2024 系统文献综述(PubMed/WoS/Scopus 等),按能耗/废弃物/碳足迹/LCA 四维归纳
contributions.evaluation: 定性:采购活动占实验室碳排>50%(法国 100 实验室 6.3 tCO2e/人;某病理室采购+运输占 71%);实验室能耗为普通商用空间 4-5 倍
contributions.domain: 实验室可持续性/绿色科研
contributions.source_quote: laboratory procurement contributes over 50% of greenhouse gas emissions, exceeding combined emissions from travel, commuting, and heating

contributions.purpose: 提出整合式可持续框架
contributions.mechanism: AI 楼宇优化 + 循环经济(许可链资源共享)+ "教育传染"行为改变模型
contributions.evaluation: 声称可提升可持续实践采纳率 60%、年碳排降 45%;AI 楼宇控制降能耗>20%
contributions.source_quote: Simulation and case studies suggest this approach can enhance adoption of sustainable practices by 60% and reduce annual laboratory carbon emissions by 45%.

contributions.purpose: 提出"教育传染"行为改变机制
contributions.mechanism: 四阶段(基础/实施/倡导/扩散)+ 游戏化/同伴认可反馈环
contributions.evaluation: 称 15% 初始采纳即可指数扩散,较传统政策提升约 60% 采纳率
contributions.source_quote: Exponential diffusion becomes achievable with merely 15% initial adoption, demonstrating approximately 60% increased adoption rates compared to conventional policy approaches

notes: desk-reject。多处数据/结构红旗:(1)摘要与结论反复宣称"60% 采纳提升、45% 碳排下降"来自"Simulation and case studies",但 Methods 只描述文献综述,全文无任何仿真设计/数据/参数——数字系凭空断言(fabricated/unsupported)。(2)重复章节:4.2 与 4.3 两个小节标题均为"Educational Contagion Framework"(4.3 实为 AI 楼宇优化,标题错置=幻影/复制粘贴);4.1"Circular Economy Approach"整段与 3.2 案例研究逐字重复。(3)引用错乱:正文引用编号与参考文献表内容不匹配(如正文[3]"Wet Lab Accelerator"对应表中[7]),checklist 自曝"Inappropriate citations:indiscriminate citation of papers unrelated to the research topic"。(4)p.302-305 出现 [1]..[75] 整块引用堆砌(幻影引用块)。checklist:各环节 Liner AI 主导 80-90%;自曝重复响应、乱引、缺乏上下文理解。非实证综述+框架,适配为 finding+method。
